title: Ruled structure
summary: Hairline rules divide columns, list rows and FAQ entries, so the grid is visible like a printed table.
use_when: FAQ, pricing tables, three-up value props.
avoid_when: Busy imagery-led layouts, where the rules fight the pictures.
recipe:
.row + .row { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.cols > * { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 24px; }
